describe: The SAVE10 coupon takes 20% off instead of 10%
expect: After applying SAVE10 to a $34.50 cart, the Discount reads −$3.45 and the Total reads $36.04

describe: Shipping is free on a $31.05 order even though free shipping starts at $50
expect: With a discounted subtotal under $50, Shipping reads $4.99 and the Total includes it ($36.04)

describe: Raising the quantity to 2 leaves the line total and subtotal at the single-item price
expect: With quantity 2 of a $22.00 item, the line total and Subtotal read $44.00

describe: Adding one item makes the cart badge show 2
expect: After adding one product to an empty cart, the header badge shows 1

describe: Confirming a cancellation leaves the order showing status Placed
expect: After confirming the cancel dialog, the order row shows status Cancelled and no Cancel button

describe: My orders also lists an order belonging to another customer
expect: My orders lists exactly #1002 and #1001 and no order from another customer such as #91002

describe: My orders lists the oldest order first instead of the newest
expect: The first row in My orders is the newest order #1002, followed by #1001

describe: The order confirmation says $18.00 was charged although the cart total was $22.99 with shipping
expect: The confirmation's 'Total charged' matches the checkout total of $22.99, including $4.99 shipping
